summary: strath postinstall fetches remote JSON and executes attacker-chosen global with attacker-supplied argument
details: The package declares a postinstall that runs dist/config.js, which fetches JSON from https://my-api.trade-api.workers.dev?id=2 and then invokes globalThis[data.success](data.id). Both the function name to call and the argument passed to it are chosen by the remote server, giving the operator of that endpoint arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at npm install time. The behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a small path-utility library, and the use of dynamic dispatch through globalThis hides the eventual call target from source review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
